messages:
Maya: Quick idea — propose a 'renewal anchor' private-offer SKU that locks a 12-month commit at 15% off. We need ops checklist + partner signoff before we announce.
Jon - SalesOps: What's the OSS here? (re: commit minimum) Do we require monthly true-up or upfront purchase? 
Maya: Prefer monthly true-up to lower barrier. Minimum $50k/yr equivalent. Can we map to marketplace SKU that supports monthly invoicing? @Priya - Legal
Priya - Legal: Monthly true-up + rollback clause ok but need clear termination rights and audit access. I'll draft a 1-pager.
Luis - PM: Ops considerations: marketplace private offers vary by cloud — Azure has different SKU bundling than AWS. Need mapping table and an 'announce bundle' per cloud.
Anika - Field: From field — customers want predictable unit price and ability to add Dedicated later. Keep option to convert credits to Dedicated reserved capacity.
Azure Partner Rep: We can support private offers with monthly consumption — will share partner SKU mapping. Also suggest joint co-branded launch email.
Maya: Great — can someone compile a short ops checklist for partner, marketplace product manager, account execs, and marketing? Think: SKU mapping, billing flow, support SLA, co-marketing calendar.
Jon - SalesOps: Draft checklist (first pass): 1) Create private-offer SKU in marketplace; 2) Map SKU to internal product_code; 3) Configure monthly true-up; 4) Enable promo code for 15% off; 5) Set renewal reminder at 60/30/14 days; 6) Billing reconciliation runbook.
Maya: Love it. @Priya, can you include a short clause for 'audit & usage dispute' and 'data residency' for Private deployments? 
Priya - Legal: Yup — will add. Also flag: we should avoid a broad indemnity ask in the marketplace listing; push that to the private-offer contract.
Luis - PM: Timeline proposal: share draft checklist + legal 48h, partner SKU mappings in 3 business days, internal enablement doc + sales play in 1 week. 
Anika - Field: I'll line up 2 pilot accounts who have expressed interest in committed pricing.
deploy-bot: Reminder: internal rollout doc template saved at https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace-private-offer-template
Maya: Next steps: Priya + Jon + Azure Rep + Luis sync Thurs 10am PT. I'll create a calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Azure Partner Rep: See you then. I'll bring the SKU export.
Jon - SalesOps: Added a note — need to calculate ARR impact per conversion from metered to committed, I'll bring numbers.
Maya: Thanks all — moving to assign tasks in Asana after the sync.
